shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone slab
rounded/curved contour at the top of the field
justification: Both are shallow relief on rounded-topped upright slabs and both contain disc-like and curved arc forms, but that is about as generic as carved shapes get. A shows a clearly organised figural scene — two standing human/animal-headed figures facing each other beneath a winged/arched canopy with framed text registers — whereas B shows only amorphous overlapping ovals and lobes with no figures, no registers and no legible relationships between elements.
